description: This Java class `AcknowledgementsJsonParser` parses JSON objects representing acknowledgements into `Acknowledgements` objects. It handles validation, extraction of entity IDs, entity type, acknowledgements list, headers, and status code, with robust exception handling.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsJsonParser
classes.description: A generic final class that implements a function to parse a JsonObject into an Acknowledgements instance, handling validation and parsing of embedded acknowledgement objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance with a specified AcknowledgementJsonParser.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides Function.apply; parses a JsonObject into Acknowledgements with error handling.

methods.name: tryToParseJsonObject
methods.description: Encapsulates the parsing process with exception translation for different JSON parsing errors.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Main parsing method that extracts entity ID, entity type, acknowledgements list, and headers, then constructs an Acknowledgements object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Extracts the entity ID string from JSON and converts it into an EntityIdWithType.

methods.name: getAcknowledgements
methods.description: Extracts acknowledgements list from the JSON object, filtering out schema version fields.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles parsing of acknowledgment value which could be an array or a single object.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementFromObject
methods.description: Parses a JsonValue to an Acknowledgement object, ensuring it is a JSON object.

methods.name: validateEntityId
methods.description: Checks that the entity ID of a parsed acknowledgement matches the expected entity ID.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and constructs DittoHeaders from JSON.

methods.name: validateEntityType
methods.description: Verifies that the entity type read from JSON matches the expected type.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts and converts a status code from JSON, ensuring it's supported.

methods.name: validateStatusCode
methods.description: Checks that the actual status code matches the expected one.
